comment: Pinned downloadable assets for the one-command release builds. Digests for assets that already ship a *.sha256 pin file (linux python-runtime) stay authoritative in those files; this table holds URLs/versions plus sha256 for assets that had pins only inline in legacy build scripts.

buildbot_worker.note: GPL redistribution approval required before bundling (see docs/orchestration-replacement.md). Wheels are pip-downloaded for win_amd64/cp312 at build time; linux controller wheels under 3rdparty/buildbot/.

get_pip.version: pip 25.x bootstrap (pinned 2026-11-16; only used when ensurepip is absent)

pip_wheel.note: bundled into worker wheels/ dirs so `get-pip.py --no-index --find-links` can install pip fully offline
